title: AioLM benchmark publication request v1
description: Exact publication wrapper. benchmark is a reviewed public snapshot; description_md is Markdown paragraphs/lists/HTTP(S) links/code blocks only, max 4000 Unicode codepoints. Legacy bare submissions are accepted with an empty description. Whole request UTF-8 must not exceed 4MiB; rows must not exceed 10000.

description_md.description: Markdown only; no HTML, images, executable URLs, or MDX. Enforced as 4000 codepoints in code; rendering policy suppresses unsafe content.
